mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rating1707 (UserID, MovieID, Score, RatingTime) VALUES (#{rating.userId}, #{rating.movieId}, #{rating.score}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE Score = VALUES(Score), RatingTime = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE rating1707 SET Score = #{rating.score}, RatingTime = NOW() WHERE UserID = #{rating.userId} AND MovieID = #{rating.movieId}
mapper.select: SELECT movie1707.*, rating1707.Score, rating1707.RatingTime FROM rating1707 JOIN movie1707 ON rating1707.MovieID = movie1707.MovieID WHERE UserID = #{userId} AND movie1707.MovieID = #{movieId}

SELECT r.RatingID as ratingId, r.UserID as userId, r.MovieID as movieId, r.Score as score, r.RatingTime as ratingTime, m.Title as title, m.ReleaseYear as releaseYear, m.Duration as duration, m.Genre as genre, m.PosterUrl as posterUrl FROM rating1707 r JOIN movie1707 m ON r.MovieID = m.MovieID WHERE r.UserID = #{userId}
SELECT AVG(Score) FROM rating1707 WHERE MovieID = #{movieId}
